title: Designing NLP Systems That Adapt to Diverse Worldviews
reasoning: The paper focuses on the concept of 'weltanschauung' (worldview) and how an individual's 'web of beliefs', 'values', and 'culture' influence the interpretation of language. It specifically addresses epistemology and hermeneutics by arguing that meaning is tied to subjective worldviews, and it uses annotator political values as metadata to improve model performance.
